_comment: Test data corrections on top of the Katalon .tc defaults, per scenario. Applied before data files and KAT_<Variable> env overrides. Say why in _why. {MMddHHmmss} (any Java date pattern) becomes the run's time.

KAT-001._why: LOA price 455000 < 2 products x 10 x 30000 = 600000 (ERR-700125); File Reference No. must be unique per LOA (ERR-700027); supplier must be the company of KAT-007's supplier account MOFFLROSNEW3 (default 'BUMI' picks BUMI WARISAN MAJU, whose task KAT-007 can't see)

KAT-007._why: Katalon default P_Item_Code is empty, SIT item search needs an 8-digit UNSPSC code (ERR-716006, ERR-715026); 10101703 from item 101017030000000000 in Desktop/Akta 882 RUU/Excel for Katalon Data Prep/DP PI Add to compare.xlsx
